# `faction` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "faction" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/faction/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique faction id, e.g. "rootcellar". Stable once shipped (saves). |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (editor, docs and debug tools). |
| `notes` | string | required | Who belongs and why these stances (canon), for owner review. |
| `towardPlayer` | `"ally"` \| `"friendly"` \| `"neutral"` \| `"wary"` \| `"hostile"` \| `"prey"` \| `"predator"` | `"neutral"` | Starting stance of members toward the player; play can change it. |
| `towardMembers` | `"ally"` \| `"friendly"` \| `"neutral"` \| `"wary"` \| `"hostile"` \| `"prey"` \| `"predator"` | `"ally"` | Stance of members toward each other. |
| `towardOthers` | `"ally"` \| `"friendly"` \| `"neutral"` \| `"wary"` \| `"hostile"` \| `"prey"` \| `"predator"` | `"neutral"` | Stance toward any faction not listed in `relations`. |
| `relations` | list of object | `[]` | Stances toward specific factions that differ from `towardOthers`. |
| `relations[].faction` | ref → faction | required | The other faction. |
| `relations[].stance` | `"ally"` \| `"friendly"` \| `"neutral"` \| `"wary"` \| `"hostile"` \| `"prey"` \| `"predator"` | required | This faction’s stance toward the other one. |
| `relations[].mutual` | boolean | `false` | Also give the other faction the mirrored stance toward this one (prey ↔ predator, others unchanged) unless it declares its own. |
